gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: To use this application, you need:
gettingStarted.item2: Access to the Metropolia network or VPN
gettingStarted.item3: Google Chrome browser (recommended for the best experience)
gettingStarted.pwa: This application is built as a Progressive Web App (PWA) and optimized for Chrome. For the best experience, we recommend using Chrome, where you can install it as a desktop application. On mobile devices, you can add the app to your home screen: on Android, tap the menu (⋮) and select "Add to Home screen", on iOS tap the share button and choose "Add to Home Screen".

login.title: Cannot log in?
login.description: Make sure you are connected to the Metropolia network or VPN

connection.title: Connection issues?
connection.description: Check your internet connection and try refreshing the page

iphone.title: Issues with iPhone?
iphone.description: If you are using an iPhone, make sure iCloud Private Relay is disabled, as it may interfere with VPN connectivity. You can disable it in Settings > Apple ID > iCloud > Private Relay.

scaling.title: Display scaling issues?
scaling.description: This website is designed with 100% display scaling in mind. If your device uses different scaling settings, the content may appear too large or too small. Adjust your browser zoom or system display scaling for optimal viewing.

about.title: About the Metropolia Attendance app
about.description: Metropolia Attendance is a comprehensive attendance tracking system designed specifically for Metropolia University of Applied Sciences. This platform represents a significant step forward in modernizing how student participation is managed and recorded.
about.modernization: Our system streamlines the traditional attendance-taking process by replacing manual paper-based methods with an efficient digital solution. It provides real-time tracking, automated reporting, and seamless integration with Metropolia’s existing digital infrastructure.
about.benefits: For students, the platform offers an easy way to mark attendance and track participation history. Teachers benefit from automated attendance management, allowing them to focus more on teaching and less on administrative tasks.
